answers.solution: The Mandu Festival is held at Mandu (Mandav) in the Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh. It celebrates the town's history, culture and monuments.
The Godavari is called the Dakshin Ganga (Ganga of the South) because it is the longest river of peninsular India.
A narrow strip of land joining two larger land masses is called an isthmus, for example the Isthmus of Panama.
The currency of Bangladesh is the Taka.
The Bay of Bengal is the largest bay in the world. It lies east of India.
